subject: Film & Cinema
title: Social Media and Micro-Cinema
description: A 60-second lesson on Social Media and Micro-Cinema.

hook.text: A 60-second video on TikTok can be seen by more people than most Cannes winners.

buildup.text: Social media has created new forms of short-form visual storytelling with massive audiences.

discovery.text: Some creators use phone cameras and editing apps to produce genuinely cinematic work.

twist.text: Purists reject social media as cinema. But the boundaries keep blurring.

climax.text: If cinema is moving images that tell stories, then the platform doesn't define the art.

punchline.text: Cinema fits in your pocket now.

quiz.question: How is social media affecting cinema?
options: It's creating new forms of short-form visual storytelling
